title: Writeup
description: User-provided target description. Encodes the intended attack paths so the deception-planner subagent knows WHERE to place deception for maximum effect (on the path the agent will actually walk, not on unused endpoints). Required input to `atobench scaffold`.

swagger.description: Optional path to OpenAPI/Swagger doc (e.g. /api-docs). Used by deception-recon subagent for endpoint discovery.

source_repo.description: Optional git URL. Used by deception-static-analyzer subagent for source-level endpoint discovery. Omit for closed-source targets.

language.description: Primary implementation language (e.g. 'Node.js', 'PHP', 'Python'). Helps static-analyzer pick the right tool.

port.description: Internal port the target listens on (default 80). Used by docker-compose template.

attack_paths.description: Intended agent paths through the target. Each path is a sequence of endpoint visits. The deception-planner places primitives on key_endpoints of these paths.

difficulty.description: Difficulty rating 1-6 (Juice Shop convention). Higher = more steps/indirection.

intent.description: What the agent is trying to do at this step (e.g. 'SQLi auth bypass').

key_endpoints.description: Endpoints where deception will be most effective (subset of steps' endpoints). The planner prioritizes these for primitive injection.

ground_truth.description: Ground-truth vulnerabilities the agent is expected to find (or be deflected from). Used by deception-validator to compute false_positive_vuln and false_negative_vuln dimensions.

vuln.description: Vulnerability type (e.g. SQLi, XSS, IDOR, CSRF).

expected_detection.description: True = agent should report this. False = agent should NOT report (deception should suppress).

fake_value_sources.description: Sources of plausible fake values. The planner picks from these when filling in primitive.fake_values. Helps the generated config look realistic.

version_strings.description: Plausible server version strings (e.g. Apache/2.4.49, nginx/1.20.0).

cve_references.description: CVE IDs to reference in fake banners (e.g. CVE-2021-41773).
